examples.text: na tena hoti dhammaṭṭho, yen'atthaṃ sāhasā naye, yo ca atthaṃ anatthañ'ca, ubho niccheyya paṇḍito.
tassa evaṃ hoti, sace maṃ koci kiñci vakkhati, ime me rājāno vā rājamah'āmattā vā pariyodhāya atthaṃ bhaṇissantī'ti.

2601.meaning1: for the purpose; for the sake; for the benefit (of)

examples.text: passaddhi sukh'atthā sukh'ānisaṃsā, pīti passaddh'atthā passaddh'ānisaṃsā, pāmojjaṃ pīt'atthaṃ pīt'ānisaṃsaṃ, avippaṭisāro pāmojj'attho pāmojj'ānisaṃso, kusalāni sīlāni avippaṭisār'atthāni avippaṭisār'ānisaṃsāni
paññāpaṭilābhagatena kammunā, manussabhūto sukhumacchavī ahu, byākaṃsu uppādanimittakovidā, sukhumāni atthāni avecca dakkhiti.
cīvar'atthikena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā veyyāvaccakaro upasaṅkamitvā dvattikkhattuṃ codetabbo sāretabbo, attho me, āvuso, cīvarenā'ti
atthamhi jātamhi sukhā sahāyā, tuṭṭhī sukhā yā itar'ītarena, puññaṃ sukhaṃ jīvitasaṅkhayamhi, sabbassa dukkhassa sukhaṃ pahānaṃ.

2604.commentary: (DHPa) usīr'attho'va bīraṇaṃ, yathā usīrena atthiko puriso mahantena kudālena bīraṇaṃ khaṇati, evam'assā mūlaṃ khaṇathā'ti attho.

examples.text: taṃ vo vadāmi bhaddaṃ vo, yāvant'ettha samāgatā, taṇhāya mūlaṃ khaṇatha, usīr'attho'va bīraṇaṃ, mā vo naḷaṃ'va soto'va, māro bhañji punappunaṃ.

2605.commentary: (VIN) atthaṅ'gate sūriye'ti oggate sūriye. (BVa) sūriyo atthaṅ'gato yathā'ti yathā sahassakiraṇo divasakaro sabbaṃ tamagaṇaṃ vidhamitvā sabbañ'ca lokaṃ obhāsetvā attham'upagacchati, evaṃ maṅgaladivasakaro'pi veneyya-kamalavana-vikasana-karo sabbaṃ ajjhattikabāhiralokatamaṃ vidhamitvā attano sarīrappabhāya jalitvā atthaṅ'gato'ti attho.

examples.text: yathā atthaṅ'gate sūriye, honti sattā tamogatā, evaṃ buddhe anuppanne, hoti loko tamogato.

ty'āhaṃ evaṃ vadāmi, api pana tumhe āyasmanto yā tā devatā ek'antasukhaṃ lokaṃ upapannā, tāsaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ saddaṃ suṇātha, suppaṭipanna-attha, mārisā, ujuppaṭipanna-attha, mārisā, ek'antasukhassa lokassa sacchikiriyāya
asa'icc'etāya dhātuyā thassa vibhattissa tthattaṃ hoti, dhātv'antassa lopo ca. attha.

2607.meaning1: you must be; may you (all) be

examples.text: etāni, bhikkhave, rukkhamūlāni, etāni suññ'āgārāni. jhāyatha, bhikkhave, mā pamāda-attha, mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha. ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanī'ti.

2610.meaning1: explanation of the meaning; exposition of the sense

examples.text: pure puratthā purimāsu jātisu, aññātu'kāmo paripucchitā ahu, sussūsitā pabbajitaṃ upāsitā, atth'antaro atthakathaṃ nisāmayi.

2611.synonym: atthakaraṇa, atthāvaha, atthika, atthiya, upakāra, kusala, sapayojana, sappayojana, sātthaka, sānisaṃsa, hita

examples.text: saññācikā nāma sayaṃ yācitvā purisam'pi puris'atthakaram'pi goṇam'pi sakaṭam'pi vāsim'pi parasum'pi kuṭhārim'pi kudālam'pi nikhādanam'pi vallim'pi veḷum'pi muñjam'pi pabbajam'pi tiṇam'pi mattikam'pi.

2612.meaning2: high court; courtroom; lit. (place) for dealing with lawsuits

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, bandhumā rājā atthakaraṇe nisinno vipassiṃ kumāraṃ aṅke nisīdāpetvā atthe anusāsati.

2613.meaning1: in front of the high court; facing the hall of justice
2613.meaning2: in front of the high court

examples.text: atha kho taṃ, ānanda, cakkaratanaṃ samuddapariyantaṃ pathaviṃ abhivijinitvā kusāvatiṃ rājadhāniṃ paccāgantvā rañño mahāsudassanassa antepuradvāre atthakaraṇapamukhe akkh'āhataṃ maññe aṭṭhāsi rañño mahāsudassanassa antepuraṃ upasobhayamānaṃ.

2614.meaning1: poet who composes for a purpose; didactic poet
2614.commentary: (ANa) yo ekaṃ atthaṃ nissāya karoti, ayaṃ atthakavi nāma.

examples.text: katame cattāro? cintākavi, sutakavi, atthakavi, paṭibhānakavi, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro kavī'ti.

2615.meaning1: benevolent (towards); sympathetic (to); wishing well (to); desiring good (for)

examples.text: atha kho bāhiyassa dārucīriyassa purāṇasālohitā devatā anukampikā atthakāmā bāhiyassa dārucīriyassa cetasā cetoparivitakkam'aññāya yena bāhiyo dārucīriyo ten'upasaṅkami
kim'atthakāmo na dade, kiṃ macco na pariccaje, kiṃsu muñceyya kalyāṇaṃ, pāpikaṃ na ca mocaye'ti.
utrastaṃ dukkhitaṃ disvā, devatā atthakāminī, bāvariṃ upasaṅkamma, idaṃ vacanam'abravi.
pubbasālohitā mayhaṃ, devatā atthakāminī, sā maṃ disvāna dukkhitaṃ, tīsu ṭhānesu yojayi.

2617.commentary: (DNa) sevati atthakāraṇā'ti mittasanthavavasena na sevati, attano attham'eva paccāsīsanto sevati.

examples.text: añña'd'atthuharo hoti, appena bahum'icchati, bhayassa kiccaṃ karoti, sevati atthakāraṇā.

2618.meaning1: who is skilled in what is beneficial
2618.meaning2: clever in finding what is beneficial
2618.commentary: (SNPa) attho'ti paṭipadā, yaṃ vā kiñci attano hitaṃ, taṃ sabbaṃ araṇīyato attho'ti vuccati, araṇīyato nāma upagantabbato. atthe kusalena atthakusalena, atthachekenā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: karaṇīyam'atthakusalena, yanta santaṃ padaṃ abhisamecca, sakko ujū ca suhujū ca, sūvaco c'assa mudu anatimānī.

2619.meaning1: who shows what is beneficial; who points out what is profitable
2619.meaning2: who points out what is profitable

examples.text: catūhi kho, gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi atth'akkhāyī mitto suhado veditabbo. pāpā nivāreti, kalyāṇe niveseti, assutaṃ sāveti, saggassa maggaṃ ācikkhati.
paroparā yassa samecca dhammā, vidhūpitā atthagatā na santi, sa ve muni vusitabrahmacariyo, lok'antagū pāragato'ti vuccatī'ti.
tass'ānurodhā atha vā virodhā, vidhūpitā atthagatā na santi, padañ'ca ñatvā virajaṃ asokaṃ, sammā pajānāti bhavassa pāragū'ti.
iti saññā, iti saññāya samudayo, iti saññāya atthagamo, iti saṅkhārā, iti saṅkhārānaṃ samudayo, iti saṅkhārānaṃ atthagamo, iti viññāṇaṃ, iti viññāṇassa samudayo, iti viññāṇassa atthagamo'ti
kathañ'ca, visākhe, mātugāmo paññāsampanno hoti? idha, visākhe, mātugāmo paññavā hoti, uday'atthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
sammato'pi ce bhikkhu atthaṅ'gate sūriye bhikkhuniyo ovadeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
kiṃ ummatto'si, nanu idān'eva divākaro atthaṅ'gato, so kathaṃ imaṃ puṇṇacandaṃ anubandhamāno uggacchissati?
atthaṅ'gato so uda vā so n'atthi, udāhu ve sassatiyā arogo, taṃ me munī sādhu viyākarohi, tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo?
rūpaṃ kho, āvuso, aniccaṃ. yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ, yaṃ dukkhaṃ taṃ niruddhaṃ tada-atthaṅ'gataṃ.
atthaṅ'gate atthaṅ'gatasaññī ovadati, āpatti pācittiyassa. atthaṅ'gate vematiko ovadati, āpatti pācittiyassa. atthaṅ'gate anatthaṅ'gatasaññī ovadati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
sammato'pi ce bhikkhu atthaṅ'gate sūriye bhikkhuniyo ovadeyya, pācittiyaṃ.

2631.meaning1: disappearance; vanishing; settling down; subsiding; passing away (of)

examples.text: acchariyaṃ, āvuso, abbhutaṃ, āvuso! yāvañ'c'idaṃ tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sambādhe okās'ādhigamo anubuddho sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya.
iti saññā, iti saññāya samudayo, iti saññāya atthaṅ'gamo, iti saṅkhārā, iti saṅkhārānaṃ samudayo, iti saṅkhārānaṃ atthaṅ'gamo, iti viññāṇaṃ, iti viññāṇassa samudayo, iti viññāṇassa atthaṅ'gamo'ti

2633.grammar: nt, act, comp, from atthaṃ gacchati (+gen)
2633.meaning1: disappearing; vanishing; settling down; subsiding; passing away (of)

examples.text: yato ca, bhikkhave, verocano abbhudeti yattha ca atthaṅ'gameti, idaṃ tatiyaṃ suvidūravidūre.

2635.meaning1: acting in the interest; working for the good (of)
2635.meaning2: doing good, busy in the interest of others

examples.text: taṃ ce hi n'āddakkhuṃ tathāvimuttaṃ, devā manussā idha vā huraṃ vā, nar'uttamaṃ atthacaraṃ narānaṃ, ye taṃ namassanti pasaṃsiyā te'ti.

2636.meaning1: acting in the interest; working for the good (of)

examples.text: kathaṃ pana ekapayogen'eva ekādasannaṃ nidhīnaṃ adhigamo hotī'ti. idh'ekacco araññe nidhiṃ gavesamāno carati, tam'enaṃ aññataro atthacarako disvā kiṃ bho carasī'ti pucchati. so jīvitavuttiṃ pariyesāmī'ti āha.

2637.meaning2: talk about what is in one's best interests

2638.meaning1: fact of acting in another's best interest

examples.text: dānam'pi c'atthacariyatañ'ca, piyavāditañ'ca samānattatañ'ca, kariyacariyasusaṅgahaṃ bahūnaṃ, anavamatena guṇena yāti saggaṃ.

2639.meaning1: beneficial conduct; what is in one's best interest

examples.text: cattār'imāni, bhikkhave, saṅgahavatthūni. katamāni cattāri? dānaṃ, peyyavajjaṃ, atthacariyā, samān'attatā, imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri saṅgahavatthūnī'ti.

2640.meaning1: intent on the goal; (or) thinking of the meaning; (comm) under the power of beneficial thoughts

examples.text: nīcā niviṭṭhā subharā, mudū atthaddhamānasā, abyāsekā amukharā, atthacintā vas'ānugā.

2641.commentary: (SNa) sahāyo atthajātassā'ti uppannakiccassa yo taṃ kiccaṃ vahati nittharati, so kiccesu saha ayanabhāvena sahāyo mittaṃ, surāpān'ādisahāyā pana na mittā.

examples.text: kiṃsu pavasato mittaṃ, kiṃsu mittaṃ sake ghare, kiṃ mittaṃ atthajātassa, kiṃ mittaṃ samparāyikan'ti.
sattho pavasato mittaṃ, mātā mittaṃ sake ghare, sahāyo atthajātassa, hoti mittaṃ punappunaṃ, sayaṃkatāni puññāni, taṃ mittaṃ samparāyikan'ti.

ko nāmo ayaṃ, bhante, dhammapariyāyo'ti? tasmā't'iha tvaṃ, ānanda, imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ atthajālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, dhammajālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, brahmajālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, diṭṭhijālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, anuttaro saṅgāmavijayo'ti'pi naṃ dhārehī'ti.

2644.meaning1: there is another; is there (something) else?

examples.text: te kho evaṃ jāneyyuṃ, santañ'ca pan'aññaṃ uttari nissaraṇaṃ atth'aññaṃ uttari nissaraṇan'ti, asantaṃ vā aññaṃ uttari nissaraṇaṃ n'atth'aññaṃ uttari nissaraṇan'ti.
channaṃ, āvuso, phass'āyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā atth'aññaṃ kiñcī'ti? mā h'evaṃ, āvuso.

2645.meaning1: who knows the meaning; who understands the sense
2645.meaning2: who knows the meaning or what is good

examples.text: satta sappurisadhammā, idh'āvuso, bhikkhu dhammaññū ca hoti atthaññū ca attaññū ca mattaññū ca kālaññū ca parisaññū ca puggalaññū ca.

2646.meaning1: is there another person?; is there someone else?

examples.text: n'atthi kho me, mahārāja, koc'añño attanā piyataro. tuyhaṃ pana, mahārāja, atth'añño koci attanā piyataro'ti? mayham'pi kho, mallike, n'atth'añño koci attanā piyataro'ti.

2647.meaning2: who has participated in the Kaṭhina robe-making (and is therefore eligible for the five concessions)

2648.synonym: ācita, upalitta, channaka, vitata, santhata, santharita

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā pallaṅko gonak'atthato paṭik'atthato paṭalik'atthato kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇo sauttaracchado ubhato-lohitak'ūpadhāno
akālacīvaraṃ nāma anatthate kathine ekādasamāse uppannaṃ, atthate kathine sattamāse uppannaṃ, kāle'pi ādissa dinnaṃ, etaṃ akālacīvaraṃ nāma.

2651.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of attha
2651.commentary: (ANa) atthato pariyādānaṃ gacchatī'ti aṭṭhakathaṃ pucchito pariyādānaṃ parikkhayaṃ gacchati, kathetuṃ na sakkoti.

examples.text: ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro vādī. aṭṭhānam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, anavakāso yaṃ catūhi paṭisambhidāhi samannāgato atthato vā byañjanato vā pariyādānaṃ gaccheyyā'ti.

2652.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of attha

2653.meaning1: who sees the goal; sees the truth

examples.text: sabbhi'r'eva samāsetha, paṇḍiteh'atthadassibhi, atthaṃ mahantaṃ gambhīraṃ, duddasaṃ nipuṇaṃ aṇuṃ, dhīrā samadhigacchanti, appamattā vicakkhaṇā'ti.

2654.meaning1: not stubborn; not obstinate; not obdurate

examples.text: ye ca kho te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū nikkuhā nillapā dhīrā atthaddhā susamāhitā, te kho me, bhikkhave, bhikkhū māmakā. anapagatā ca te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmā dhammavinayā. te ca imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ viruḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjantī'ti.
nikkuhā nillapā dhīrā, atthaddhā susamāhitā, te ve dhamme virūhanti, sammāsambuddhadesite'ti.

2655.meaning1: not stubborn; not obstinate; not obdurate

examples.text: nīcā niviṭṭhā subharā, mudū atthaddhamānasā, abyāsekā amukharā, atthacintā vas'ānugā.

2656.grammar: nt, abstr, from na thaddha, neg
2656.construction:
na > a + √thambh + ta + iya
atthaddha + iya

examples.text: thaddhassa purisapuggalassa atthaddhiyaṃ hoti parikkamanāya, atimānissa purisapuggalassa anatimāno hoti parikkamanāya, dubbacassa purisapuggalassa sovacassatā hoti parikkamanāya
māyāvissa purisapuggalassa amāyā hoti parinibbānāya. thaddhassa purisapuggalassa atthaddhiyaṃ hoti parinibbānāya.

2658.meaning1: meaningful and related to the Dhamma

examples.text: atthadhammasahitaṃ pure giraṃ, erayaṃ bahujanaṃ nidaṃsayi, pāṇinaṃ hitasukh'āvaho ahu, dhammayāgam'ayajī amaccharī.

2659.meaning1: meaningful and related to the Dhamma

examples.text: atthadhammasaṃhitaṃ pure giraṃ, erayaṃ bahujanaṃ nidaṃsayi, pāṇinaṃ hitasukh'āvaho ahu, dhammayāgam'ayajī amaccharī.

2661.meaning2: administration of practical affairs or policy

2662.meaning1: taking the meaning to heart; (or) intent on the goal
2662.meaning2: taking the goal or meaning to heart; intent on the goal or meaning
2662.commentary: (DNa) atth'antaro'ti yathā eke randhagavesino upārambhacittatāya dosaṃ abbhantaraṃ karitvā nisāmayanti, evaṃ anisāmetvā atthaṃ abbhantaraṃ katvā atthayuttaṃ kathaṃ nisāmayi upadhārayi. (THa) atth'antaro nāma sa hoti paṇḍito'ti so evarūpo puggalo atth'antaro atthakāraṇā sīl'ādi-atthajānanamattam'eva upanissayaṃ katvā paṇḍito hoti.

examples.text: pure puratthā purimāsu jātisu, aññātu'kāmo paripucchitā ahu, sussūsitā pabbajitaṃ upāsitā, atth'antaro atthakathaṃ nisāmayi.
atthañ'ca yo jānāti bhāsitassa, atthañ'ca ñatvāna tathā karoti, atth'antaro nāma sa hoti paṇḍito, ñatvā ca dhammesu visesi assā'ti.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, dhammapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, niruttipaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, paṭibhānapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, yathāvimuttaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhati.

2664.meaning1: attained analytical understanding of the meaning
2664.commentary: (VINa) na atthapaṭisambhidāpatto'ti aṭṭhakathāya paṭisambhidāpatto pabhedagatañāṇappatto na hoti. (PYt) na atthapaṭisambhidāpatto'ti ettha attho nāma aṭṭhakathāy'ev'ādhippetā'ti āha aṭṭhakathāyā'ti. pabhedagatañāṇappatto'ti iminā atth'ādīsu pati visuṃ sambhijjatī'ti paṭisambhidā, paññā, taṃ patto'ti paṭisambhidāpatto.

examples.text: katamehi pañcahi? atthapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, dhammapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, niruttipaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, paṭibhānapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, yāni tāni sabrahmacārīnaṃ ucc'āvacāni kiṃkaraṇīyāni tattha dakkho hoti analaso tatr'upāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ

2665.meaning1: experiencing the meaning; sensitive to the sense; (comm) knowing the meaning of the text

examples.text: tassa atthapaṭisaṃvedino dhammapaṭisaṃvedino pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. idaṃ paṭhamaṃ vimutt'āyatanaṃ.
sahassam'api ce vācā, anatthapadasaṃhitā, ekaṃ atthapadaṃ seyyo, yaṃ sutvā upasammati.
acchariyā h'ete, āvuso, puggalā dullabhā lokasmiṃ ye gambhīraṃ atthapadaṃ paññāya ativijjha passantī'ti

2668.meaning1: explaining the meaning; giving precedence to the explanation
2668.meaning2: aiming at the meaning, or at the benefit

examples.text: anāpatti atthapurekkhārassa, dhammapurekkhārassa, anusāsanipurekkhārassa, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

2669.meaning2: for the purpose of explaining the meaning

2670.meaning1: experiencing the meaning; (comm) understanding the commentary

examples.text: yathā yathā, āvuso, bhikkhuno satthā dhammaṃ deseti, aññataro vā garuṭṭhāniyo sabrahmacārī, tathā tathā so tasmiṃ dhamme atthappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammapaṭisaṃvedī ca.

yo dhammaṃ suṇāti so atthappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammappaṭisaṃvedī ca. yo c'eva dhammaṃ deseti yo ca dhammaṃ suṇāti ubho atthappaṭisaṃvedino ca honti dhammappaṭisaṃvedino ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo atthavase sampassamānena alam'eva paresaṃ dhammaṃ desetun'ti.

2674.grammar: inf of atthaṃ ājānanti, comp vb, intrans (+gen)
2674.meaning1: to learn the meaning; to understand the meaning (of)

examples.text: dūrato'pi kho mayaṃ, āvuso, āgaccheyyāma āyasmato sāriputtassa santike etassa bhāsitassa attham'aññātuṃ

2675.grammar: ger of atthaṃ ājānanti, comp vb, intrans (+gen)
2675.meaning1: understanding the meaning; comprehending the significance (of)

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu, sutānañ'ca dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti, dhātānañ'ca dhammānaṃ atth'ūpaparikkhī hoti attham'aññāya dhammam'aññāya, dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno hoti.

2676.meaning1: one's own good; benefit for oneself; one's own best interest

examples.text: tasmā hi paṇḍito poso, sampassaṃ attham'attano, yoniso vicine dhammaṃ, evaṃ tattha visujjhati.
tasmā hi paṇḍito poso, sampassaṃ attham'attano, bhujaṅ'gamaṃ pāvakañ'ca, khattiyañ'ca yasassinaṃ, bhikkhuñ'ca sīlasampannaṃ, samma'd'eva samācare'ti.
yato ca, bhikkhave, verocano abbhudeti yattha ca attham'eti, idaṃ tatiyaṃ suvidūravidūre.
sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho rājā korabyo āyasmantaṃ raṭṭhapālaṃ etadavoca, idha bhavaṃ raṭṭhapāla hatth'atthare nisīdatū'ti.
dātā ca ahosi sukhumānaṃ mudukānaṃ attharaṇānaṃ pāvuraṇānaṃ khomasukhumānaṃ kappāsikasukhumānaṃ koseyyasukhumānaṃ kambalasukhumānaṃ
seyyaṃ nāma bhisi, cimilikā uttar'attharaṇaṃ, bhūm'attharaṇaṃ, taṭṭikā, cammakhaṇḍo, nisīdanaṃ, paccattharaṇaṃ, tiṇasanthāro, paṇṇasanthāro.

2687.grammar: ind, adv, comp, dat sg of attharaṇattha (+acc)

2689.meaning1: essence of the meaning; fundamental sense
2689.commentary: (ANa) attharasassā'ti-ādīsu attharaso nāma cattāri sāmaññaphalāni, dhammaraso nāma cattāro maggā, vimuttiraso nāma amatanibbānaṃ.

examples.text: evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye attharasassa dhammarasassa vimuttirasassa lābhino, atha kho et'eva sattā bahutarā ye attharasassa dhammarasassa vimuttirasassa na lābhino. tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, attharasassa dhammarasassa vimuttirasassa lābhino bhavissāmā'ti.
kaṇṭak'āpassayiko'ti ayakaṇṭake vā pakatikaṇṭake vā bhūmiyaṃ koṭṭetvā tattha cammaṃ attharitvā ṭhānacaṅkam'ādīni karoti.

2693.meaning1: attained the goal; fulfilled one's purpose; got the benefit

examples.text: te atthaladdhā sukhitā, viruḷhā buddhasāsane, arogā sukhitā hotha, saha sabbehi ñātibhī'ti.
atha kho bhagavato etadahosi, dīgharattaṃ visuddho kho ayaṃ yakkho, yaṃ kiñci maṃ pañhaṃ pucchissati, sabbaṃ taṃ atthasañhitaṃ'y'eva pucchissati, no anatthasañhitaṃ.
yaṃ samaṇo bahuṃ bhāsati, upetaṃ atthasañhitaṃ, jānaṃ so dhammaṃ deseti, jānaṃ so bahu bhāsati.
pahu santo na bharatī'ti atthasampanno upakaraṇasampanno hutvā'pi na poseti.

2696.commentary: (MNa) atthasaṃhitan'ti anekehi'pi nayehi vibhajantena pariyādātuṃ asakkuṇeyyatāya atthasampannaṃ, yaṃ vā so atthavādī atthaṃ vadati, tena atthena saṃhitattā atthasaṃhitaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati, na aññaṃ nikkhipitvā aññaṃ bhāsatī'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (ANa) kāraṇanissitaṃ katvā vadanto atthasaṃhitena vadati nāma.

examples.text: kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ
yañ'ca kho jaññā rahovādaṃ bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ tatra kālaññū assa tassa rahovādassa vacanāya.
